english.answerChoiceInDropAreaA11y: Answer choice: {choice} in drop area for Object {number} {text}
english.introReusableA11y: This question has {total} objects that need a match. Each object has one drop area for one answer choice. Answer choices can be reused. Place an answer choice in every drop area.
english.introNotReusableA11y: This question has {total} objects that need a match. Each object has one drop area for one answer choice. Answer choices cannot be reused. Place an answer choice in every drop area.
english.keyboardHelpA11y: Use TAB to move between answer choices and drop areas, ENTER to select/drop, and ESC to cancel.
english.progressA11y: {filled} of {total} drop areas have an answer choice.
english.dropAreaFilledA11y: Drop area {number} contains the answer choice {choice}
english.availableEndA11y: End of available answer choices. Use TAB to move to an answer choice.
english.selectedA11y: Selected answer choice {choice}. Use TAB to choose a drop area.
english.notOverResponseAreaA11y: {choice} is not over a response area.
english.overDropAreaA11y: Selected drop area for Object {number} {text}. Press ENTER to move selected answer choice {choice} here or TAB to move to a different drop area.
english.overPoolFromDropAreaA11y: Press ENTER to remove selected answer choice from Object {number} drop area or TAB to move to a different drop area. Selected answer choice: {choice}. Object {number}: {text}
english.overPoolUnplacedA11y: Press ENTER to leave selected answer choice unplaced or TAB to move to a drop area. Selected answer choice: {choice}
english.placedA11y: Placed answer choice {choice} in drop area for Object {number}: {text}
english.movedA11y: Moved answer choice {choice} from Object {from} drop area to Object {to} drop area. {text}
english.removedA11y: Removed answer choice {choice} from Object {number} drop area
english.remainingA11y: {filled} of {total} drop areas have an answer choice. {available} available answer choices. Use TAB to select an answer choice.
english.completeA11y: Answer is complete. {total} of {total} drop areas have an answer choice.
english.deselectedA11y: Answer choice {choice} is no longer selected. Use TAB to select an answer choice.
english.cancelledA11y: Answer choice {choice} is no longer selected. Use TAB to move to an answer choice.
